10DLC campaign registration (use cases for a brand)

Usage:
  plivo messaging sms 10dlc campaigns [flags]
  plivo messaging sms 10dlc campaigns [command]

Aliases:
  campaigns, camp, campaign

Available Commands:
  create      Register a new campaign (spends money — TCR fee, requires --yes)
  get         Get a campaign by ID
  list        List campaigns
  update      Update mutable campaign fields

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for campaigns

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo messaging sms 10dlc campaigns [command] --help" for more information about a command.
